asta.dsmash: low spinning cut, facing right: drops into a wide low stance, sweeps the huge black broken-edged greatsword flat at ankle height in front of him to the right, then spins around on the spot and sweeps it flat at ankle height behind him to the left, then turns back to face right and rises into the fighting stance. Both legs and the whole blade stay visible and inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.bair: backward cut in mid-air, his face and body staying turned to the right: knees tucked, he twists his torso and swings the huge black broken-edged greatsword behind his back, the blade sweeping down in an arc on the left side of the picture and ending pointing down-left behind him, then he brings it back to the tucked pose. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.fthrow: forward throw, facing right: holding the invisible opponent by the collar in front of him with his free hand, he pulls it back to his chest, then shoves it hard straight forward with the palm open at full arm extension, leaning his whole body forward onto the front leg with a big step, then returns to the fighting stance. His other hand holds the huge black broken-edged greatsword the whole time; the weapon stays visible. The opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.ledge: hangs by his left hand from an invisible ledge above him, the left arm stretched straight up with the empty hand closed on nothing near the top of the picture but fully inside it, his right hand holding the huge black broken-edged greatsword pointing down beside his dangling legs, which sway gently, a seamless loop; nothing is in his raised hand: no log, no bar, no branch, no cliff, no rock, no wall. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.sspecial: Black Meteorite rush, facing right: crouches, then charges forward low with a long stride, thrusting the huge black broken-edged greatsword straight ahead, strikes three fast forward cuts in front of him, then a final rising slash, then skids to a stop and settles back into the stance. His skin, spiky hair, black cape, navy trousers and the sword keep exactly the colours of the first frame in every frame. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.uspecial: Black Hurricane, facing right: crouches, then springs straight upward spinning like a drill with the huge black broken-edged greatsword held out at arm's length and whirling around him, his body and the blade visible in every frame, ending in mid-air with the sword raised above his head, legs dangling. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.usmash: rising smash, facing right: crouches low holding the huge black broken-edged greatsword low in front of him with both hands, then swings it up in a big arc in front of him until the blade points straight up above his head, holds it there for a moment, then lowers it back into the fighting stance. The whole blade stays inside the picture with empty space above it in every frame. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.ultimate: Black Divider: dashes forward and slashes the huge black broken-edged greatsword four times in quick succession in front of him, then winds up and swings one huge horizontal cut to the front at full extension, then returns to the stance. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.w0_ultimate: Black Meteorite: springs upward off the ground, slashing the huge black broken-edged Demon-Slayer greatsword upward three times, then raises it over his head with both hands and drops straight down, slamming the blade down to the ground in front of him, then rises back into the stance. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.w1_sspecial: Black Divider: crouches, then dashes forward low, slashing the slim black katana-like Demon Dweller Sword five times in quick succession in front of him, then one final rising cut, then skids to a stop and settles back into the ready stance holding the sword forward. The sword stays in his hand and visible in every frame. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.w1_jab: quick katana cut, facing right: holding the slim black katana-like Demon Dweller Sword with a dark guard forward in a ready stance, he draws it back, then slashes it in one fast horizontal cut in front of him at chest height, then returns to the ready stance holding it forward. The sword stays in his hand, visible and fully inside the picture in every frame. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.w0_jab: heavy weapon strike, facing right: raises the huge black broken-edged greatsword high over his right shoulder with both hands, then brings it down in one heavy diagonal cut to low in front of him, then back into the stance. The sword looks exactly like the one in his idle pose. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.spotdodge: spot dodge: quickly ducks down low on the spot, bending his knees and leaning his head and torso back so a blow passes over him, then straightens up into the stance. He keeps holding the huge black broken-edged greatsword low at his side the whole time; the weapon stays visible. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.climb: pulls himself up over the invisible ledge he is hanging from: hauls his chest up to the top of the picture, swings one knee up, then rises and stands up in the fighting stance, holding the huge black broken-edged greatsword in one hand the whole time; the pull-up takes most of the frames; no log, no bar, no branch, no cliff, no rock, no wall, no ground. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.dair: downward stab in mid-air: grips the huge black broken-edged greatsword with both hands and turns it to point straight down, the blade vertical directly beneath his feet, plunges it down, then pulls it back up to the tucked pose. The whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.bthrow: back throw: grips the invisible opponent in front of him with his free hand, twists his whole body around to the left and hurls it away behind him with a big arm swing, his throwing arm ending stretched out behind him, then turns back to face right into the fighting stance; the huge black broken-edged greatsword stays in his other hand the whole time, no slash trail; the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.dizzy: dazed and dizzy, staying in side profile facing right the whole time: knees sagging, sways slowly forward and back on the spot, head drooping and wobbling, free arm hanging loose, the huge black broken-edged greatsword held loosely in one hand with its tip lowered toward the ground, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.helpless: falls helplessly, exhausted: body limp and slumped, head drooping, both arms hanging loose above his head, legs dangling straight down, the body turning slowly, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. He keeps holding the huge black broken-edged greatsword loosely in one hand the whole time; the whole blade stays inside the picture. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.roll: dodge roll: tucks and rolls forward in a tight ball along the ground, hugging the huge black broken-edged greatsword flat against his body so the blade stays visible in every frame, then springs back up into the same stance holding it in front of him. Only Asta is drawn.
asta.walk: walks forward to the right in side profile: the body, chest and head stay turned to the right exactly like the first frame with the cape kept over his back, the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose. He keeps holding the huge black broken-edged greatsword pointed up and forward the whole time; the weapon stays visible.
asta.ledgegrab: jumps up and catches an invisible ledge above him with his left hand: the left arm stretched straight up, the empty hand closed on nothing near the top of the picture but fully inside it, his right hand holding the huge black broken-edged greatsword pointing down beside his legs, legs dangling, ending hanging still; nothing is in his raised hand: no log, no bar, no branch, no cliff, no rock, no wall. Only Asta is drawn.

ulquiorra.holdstart: pulls his right hand out of his coat pocket and thrusts the right arm straight forward at shoulder height, the hand closing on the collar of an invisible opponent in front of him, ending with the right arm fully extended forward, holding it at arm's length, the left hand still in his pocket. Only Ulquiorra is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame.

starrk.holdstart: thrusts his right arm straight forward at shoulder height, the open hand closing on the collar of an invisible opponent in front of him, ending with the right arm fully extended forward, holding it at arm's length, staying in side profile facing right the whole time, the left hand hanging at his side. Only Starrk is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame.

naruto.dizzy: dazed and dizzy after his guard breaks: stands slumped on wobbly bent knees, both arms hanging limp at his sides with open hands, head drooping and rolling slowly in a circle, eyes half closed, the whole body swaying from side to side on the spot, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.dsmash: low split kicks: drops into a deep crouch and sweeps the right leg fast along the ground far out in front of him to the right, then pivots on the spot and sweeps the other leg along the ground far out behind him to the left, the foot at ground level on the left side, then rises back into the fighting stance. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.crouch: crouches down as low as he can on the spot, facing right: knees fully bent, hips dropped right down onto his heels, torso folded forward over the knees, head ducked low, fists raised in front of his face, the whole body about half its standing height, then holds the low crouch. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.helpless: falls helplessly, exhausted: both arms hang limp and loose straight up above his head, head drooping, eyes half closed, legs dangling loosely below him, the body tilting slowly as he drops, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.usmash: upward smash: crouches low, then springs up on his toes and punches straight up with the right fist, the arm fully extended above his head pointing at the sky, then lands back in the stance. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.w0_nspecial: Sage mode, orange pigment around his eyes, his exact orange and black outfit: plants his feet wide and pushes both open palms straight forward at chest height, arms fully extended, hands empty, holds the push, then returns to the stance. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.w1_jab: Kurama chakra strike, in his exact orange and black outfit: steps forward and swipes his right hand forward in a big clawing arc at chest height, fingers curled like claws, the arm fully extended at the end, then back into the stance. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.w1_sspecial: Kyuubi mode clone dash, in his exact orange and black outfit: crouches slightly, then swings both arms forward from behind his hips and thrusts both open palms straight ahead at chest height, holds the pose, then returns to the stance. Only Naruto is drawn.
naruto.w1_ultimate: Tailed beast bomb pose, the exact orange and black outfit the whole time with only a thin golden glow outlining his body: crouches with the feet wide, brings both cupped hands together in front of his mouth and holds them there gathering power, then leans forward and thrusts both open palms straight ahead at full arm extension, holds the push, then returns to the stance. Only Naruto is drawn: no sphere, no ball, no beam, no fire, no flames, no effect.

sasuke.crouch: drops into a deep crouch on the spot and holds it, facing right: squats all the way down until the hips almost touch the heels, both knees fully bent, torso leaning forward over the knees, the head lowered to about half its standing height, fists still raised in guard in front of the face. Only Sasuke is drawn.
sasuke.dizzy: stunned and dizzy, facing right: slumps with the knees sagging and the back hunched, both arms hanging limp at his sides, the head lolling and rolling in a slow circle, the upper body tottering left and right on the spot, a seamless loop that returns exactly to the first pose. Only Sasuke is drawn.
sasuke.fsmash: powerful two-handed overhead sword slash: raises the straight sword high above and behind his head, then cuts down hard to the front, the blade ending low in front of him pointing right, holds the cut for a moment, then returns to the ready stance with the sword held upright in front. Only Sasuke is drawn.
sasuke.jab: fast one-hand thrust: from the ready stance he steps forward into a deep lunge and stabs the straight sword straight ahead to the right with his sword arm fully extended, the blade level at chest height and reaching far in front of his body, holds it for an instant, then pulls back to the ready stance. Only Sasuke is drawn.
sasuke.helpless: falls helplessly, exhausted: both arms raised limp above his head with the hands dangling, head tipped back, legs hanging loosely straight down, the body slowly turning as he drops, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Sasuke is drawn.

kakashi.crouch: crouches down very low on the spot into a deep squat: both knees bent fully, thighs pressed against the calves, hips dropped right down onto the heels so the head ends at about half his standing height, back bent forward over the knees, fists still raised in guard in front of the chest, facing right, holds the low squat. Only Kakashi is drawn.
kakashi.dspecial: summoning jutsu: drops quickly to one knee and slams his right palm flat on the ground in front of him, holds the palm pressed to the ground while staring straight ahead to the right, then pushes off and stands back up into the fighting stance. Only Kakashi is drawn: no dogs, no animals, no scroll, no smoke, no seal, no effect.
kakashi.fthrow: forward throw: from holding at arm's length with both hands, pulls both hands back to his chest while leaning back, then steps forward and shoves both open palms hard straight ahead at full arm extension, body leaning far forward, then returns to the fighting stance. Only Kakashi is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame.
kakashi.grabbed: held up by the collar from in front of him: chest pulled forward, head tilted back in pain, both hands clutching at the collar at his throat, legs kicking and squirming, body wriggling, a seamless loop. Only Kakashi is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame.
kakashi.dtilt: crouching leg sweep: stays squatted very low the whole time, hips near his heels and back bent forward, one hand touching the ground for support, swings the front leg out straight and sweeps it along the floor in front of him, then rises back into the fighting stance. Only Kakashi is drawn.
kakashi.helpless: falls helplessly, exhausted: both arms hang limp straight up above his head, the head droops back, the legs hang loose and straight below with the toes pointing down, the body slowly tilts back and forth, a seamless loop. Only Kakashi is drawn.
kakashi.nair: neutral aerial in mid-air: pulls the knees tight to the chest with the arms wrapped around the shins and does one fast forward somersault, then snaps both legs and both arms out wide in a star-shaped kick, holds it for a moment, then tucks back into the same tucked pose, the same outfit and colours the whole time. Only Kakashi is drawn.
kakashi.w1_ultimate: Susanoo: both eyes glow red, staying turned to the right in side profile the whole time, he spreads his arms wide out to the sides and holds, then swings his right arm over his shoulder in a big overhand arc and thrusts it straight forward to the right at full arm extension, holding that extended throwing pose as if hurling something huge, then returns to the stance; no Susanoo, no shuriken, no red flash, no blood, no sparks, no specks. Only Kakashi is drawn.
kakashi.walk: walks forward to the right in the same 3/4 side view as the first frame: the chest, head and eyes stay turned to the right the whole time and never turn toward the viewer, fists raised in guard, the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, both trouser legs keep the same navy blue colour, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Kakashi is drawn.

yuno.crouch: crouches down as low as he can on the spot and holds it: knees fully bent, hips dropped right down onto the heels, torso folded forward over the knees, head ducked low at about half his standing height, the right hand still raised forward, the green grimoire floating by it. Only Yuno is drawn.
yuno.dizzy: dazed and dizzy after his guard breaks: stands slumped on wobbly bent knees, both arms hanging limp at his sides, head drooping and rolling slowly in a circle, eyes half closed, the whole body swaying from side to side on the spot, the green grimoire drifting loosely beside him, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Yuno is drawn.
yuno.helpless: falls helplessly, exhausted: both arms hang limp and loose straight up above his head, head drooping, eyes half closed, legs dangling loosely below him, the cape fluttering upward, the body tilting slowly as he drops, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only Yuno is drawn.
yuno.spotdodge: spot dodge: quickly ducks down low on the spot, bending his knees and leaning his head and torso back so a blow passes over him, then straightens up into the stance, the green grimoire floating by his hand. Only Yuno is drawn: no slash, no attack, no projectile, no fire, no effect.
yuno.getupattack: lying on his back on the ground, spins on the floor and sweeps one leg in a wide circle, kicking low in front of him and then behind him, then springs up into the fighting stance, the green grimoire floating by his hand. Only Yuno is drawn.
